card.name: Football pool problem for 6 matches: ternary covering code K_3(6,1)

task.name: Football pool problem for 6 matches: ternary covering code K_3(6,1)
task.description: Choose as few words of length 6 over the alphabet {0,1,2} as possible so that every one of the 729 words differs from some chosen word in at most one position. The best known code has 73 words (van Laarhoven, Aarts, van Lint and Wille, 1989) and the best lower bound is 71.
task.contract: construct(q, n, radius) -> list of codewords; the evaluator passes this task's alphabet size q, length n and covering radius. Each codeword is a list of n integers in 0..q-1 and codewords must be distinct. Valid when every word of {0..q-1}^n is within Hamming distance radius of some codeword (checked over the whole space). Score: the number of codewords, minimized; it is an upper bound on K_q(n, radius).
